# Font manager fixtures

Five original rectangle-outline TrueType fonts and a two-face collection, generated by
`tests/make_font_manager_fonts.py`, licensed under the repository's MIT license.
No outlines are copied from third-party fonts. `fontTools` is required only to
regenerate the committed binaries.

| File | Family / style | Coverage |
|---|---|---|
| latin-serif.ttf | EXR FM Latin Serif / Regular | printable ASCII |
| cjk-serif.ttf | EXR FM CJK Serif / Regular | 一中文紅夢、。 and space |
| cjk-sans.ttf | EXR FM CJK Sans / Regular | 一中文紅夢樓 and space |
| cjk-serif-bold.ttf | EXR FM CJK Serif / Bold | 一中龍 and space |
| cjk-serif-italic.ttf | EXR FM CJK Serif / Italic | 中α and space (CJK + OTHER) |
| collection.ttc | Latin Serif + CJK Serif / Regular | ASCII + 中 across two faces |

The serif font also has a localized family name, 测试宋体. The labels describe
their test roles; all visible outlines are rectangles. U+10FFFF is deliberately
uncovered. Each ctest copies three fonts to a fresh temporary directory; the
bold face is a separate input to the selection group. The CJK serif is placed
under `字庫/` to exercise UTF-8 discovery and loading on Windows.

`fonts.conf` demonstrates ordered directories and fallback families. Production
hosts replace `font_dir` with their app and user directories, then optionally
set `platform_dirs = yes` to append platform user/system directories.
